title: penstemon rydbergii var. aggregatus
intro: Penstemon rydbergii var. aggregatus, commonly known as Aggregatum Beardtongue, is a perennial flowering plant species in the plantain family, native to the western United States. The Aggregatum Beardtongue is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as it has been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as fever, sore throats, and coughs. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe the respiratory system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Aggregatum Beardtongue include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
